**Please read before opening a pull request.**

Song Shape does not merge pull requests from forks. Fixes are written by the maintainers and land only on `main`. If you found a bug, please open an issue with the Bug report template instead: https://github.com/aiplayground226/song-shape/issues/new/choose. You'll be credited in `CHANGELOG.md` when it's fixed.

This pull request will be closed. If it shows a useful fix, link it from an issue and we'll use it as a reference.
